name: Cesar J. Barajas
office: La Puente Valley County Water District, Member, Board of Directors

items.text: Cesar J. Barajas is president of the La Puente Valley County Water District board, serving a term from 2022 to 2026. He joined the board in 2018. He holds a master's degree in civil engineering and works at a local construction company. As board president, he has presided over meetings considering budget amendments and a CalPERS contract compliance resolution.
